sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The Chaser's core gameplay mechanics are refreshingly simple yet incredibly challenging. You play as a character who needs to escape from the Chaser, and to do so, you'll need to navigate through a series of increasingly complex levels. Each level presents a new challenge, whether it's avoiding obstacles, solving puzzles, or simply making your way through a crowded room.

The game's controls are incredibly intuitive, allowing you to use your mouse, keyboard, or touch controls to play. You can move left and right, jump, and even use special abilities like a 'dash' move to get around the level quickly. But with great power comes great responsibility, and you'll need to time your movements perfectly to avoid getting caught by the Chaser.

One of the most interesting aspects of The Chaser's gameplay is the way it uses a 'time limit' mechanic. Each level has a timer that ticks away, and if you don't escape before time runs out, the Chaser will catch up to you and you'll have to start over. This adds a whole new level of tension to the gameplay, and you'll find yourself constantly trying to beat the clock to escape.

The Chaser's levels are expertly designed to challenge you in new and interesting ways, and you'll need to use all your wits and reflexes to make it through each one. But don't worry if you get stuck - the game's difficulty curve is perfectly balanced, and you'll have plenty of chances to practice and improve your skills before moving on to the next level.
